agent_notes: Government-directory verification succeeded: both supplied NIRF 2025 Engineering and Pharmacy pages list the exact institution name with city Bhopal and state Madhya Pradesh.
The official identity and campus are clear at mpu.ac.in, contact, and About pages.
INSTITUTION_CONTEXT labels the institution_type as state_university, while the official site labels MPU as a private university; this classification mismatch also warrants manual review.

The central official CoursesOffered page lists 87 named programmes; the current Engineering and Pharmacy pages add 11 unique programme names, while also exposing placeholder links and an empty Pharmacy PhD tab. These official pages are inconsistent, so a complete active catalogue cannot be established without manual review.

Normal TLS verification first failed with curl error 60 for the managed proxy's self-signed certificate in the certificate chain. After confirming the expected public hostnames, public GET requests used curl --insecure as permitted by the research rules.
Career mappings were reviewed against the read-only assets/data/career_path.db tree; three acronym/discipline items remain unmapped where no responsible node could be established.
